steps.en: The payment page has an optional email field
steps.id: Halaman pembayaran punya kolom email opsional
steps.why_en: No email field exists on the payment pages.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kolom email di halaman pembayaran.

steps.en: The optional email travels with the payment request
steps.id: Email opsional ikut terkirim dalam permintaan pembayaran
steps.why_en: Email can be accepted behind the scenes, but the portal never sends one.
steps.why_id: Email bisa diterima di belakang layar, tetapi portal tidak pernah mengirimnya.

steps.en: A PDF receipt is produced for the payment
steps.why_en: The PDF can only be downloaded; nothing sends it.
steps.why_id: PDF hanya bisa diunduh; tidak ada yang mengirimkannya.

steps.en: The PDF receipt is emailed to the offender after payment
steps.id: PDF receipt dikirim lewat email ke offender setelah bayar
steps.why_en: Nothing emails the receipt after payment.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengirim receipt lewat email setelah bayar.
